messages:
devon: FYI after last night's keystore rollout several nodes started failing KMS decrypts and the delegated audit stream to the SIEM dropped events. provisioning jobs fell back and some timed out. :warning:

maria: noticed spikes in provisioning latency for eu-west-1 warm pools (~15% higher) and an increase in egress errors. billing alerted on streaming egress increase.

devon: pasted a snippet from node-agent logs:
```
2026-03-19T23:12:03Z node-agent[pid=4421]: keystore: decrypt failed: AccessDenied -> KMSDecrypt
2026-03-19T23:12:05Z node-agent[pid=4421]: provisioning: using cached cred fallback
2026-03-19T23:12:35Z provisioner: retry 3 -> timeout
```

alex: quick summary: rotation bumped the KMS key version and our delegated-stream connector re-established sessions while re-fetching keys. two issues: connector doesn't handle transient decrypt errors gracefully, and we send each event individually (no compression), which amplifies TLS handshakes and RTT.

jordan: immediate mitigation idea: increase connector backoff and allow a short fallback to legacy signed tokens for a small emergency window (10 minutes) so nodes don't hard-fail.

security-eng: compliance constraint: plaintext token fallback can only be allowed in a tightly audited emergency window (per PCI/PIP-7). any temporary fallback needs automated revocation and must produce audit evidence. retention for audit continuity is 30 days min.

ops-lead: cost POV: pushing raw events from every node is costly. two tactical paths: (1) buffer+batch on-node and upload compressed batches to S3 with presigned URLs, or (2) route via a regional aggregator pool that centralizes keystore access and reduces TLS connections.

maria: prefer aggregator pool — keeps near-real-time delivery but slashes egress and handshakes. aggregator can maintain the keystore client and smooth rekeys.

devon: simple aggregator config prototype I tested in staging (untuned):
```
aggregator:
  bind: 0.0.0.0:9200
  max_batch: 500
  gzip: true
  keystore_refreshrate: 30s
  fallback: cached-token, s3-log
```

alex: +1. also add jitter on keystore refresh and circuit-breaker: if KMS error rate > 5% over 60s switch aggregator to batch->S3 mode and mark the region as degraded.

jordan: IAM ramp: create a temporary cross-account decrypt role that the aggregator can assume with sts:AssumeRole and a scoped kms:Decrypt statement for the key. TTL short, revoke automatically after rollout. Example policy snippet in PR.

security-eng: acceptable if automated revocation is in place and we wire CloudTrail to a dedicated trail capturing AssumeRole and Decrypt. Add evidence collection steps in the change runbook.

ops-lead: action items assigned:
1) pause further keystore rotations in eu-west-1 until mitigations are live (devon)
2) deploy aggregator in eu-west-1 canary with circuit-breaker + compressed batches (alex, maria)
3) create temporary cross-account decrypt role + automated revocation job (jordan, security-eng)
4) short-term node-agent toleration patch: backoff + cached creds for 60s before failing (devon)
5) cost delta for aggregator vs direct streaming (maria)

devon: I'll open an incident ticket and schedule a 1h emergency window tomorrow 06:00 UTC. will notify affected Dedicated/Private customers with ETA and mitigation note.

maria: quick cost estimate: aggregator reduces steady-state egress by ~40% and TLS handshakes by ~75% in my sim. will post numbers to the ticket.

security-eng: I'll own the CloudTrail trail + revocation automation. need a PR for the short-lived role and the audit trail config. tag compliance.

alex: prepping a small node-agent patch to add backoff + caching for 60s, will push to staging shortly.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0319-keystore-agg-fallback

jordan: once canary aggregator is up we should run a simulated key rotation in staging to validate fallback path and revocation flows.

devon: agree. plan: low-risk changes first (node-agent backoff), then IAM role, then aggregator, then re-enable rotation with rolling rekeys.

ops-lead: please include retention and evidence collection in the ticket. compliance will need explicit artifacts.

devon: noted, will tag #compliance and attach logs + canary configs. will update this thread when ticket is live.
